detail.body:
<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

## Motivation

<!-- Describe the purpose and goals of this pull request. -->

On Ascend NPU CI runners, Ascend SDK logs (plog) are redirected via `ASCEND_WORK_PATH`, but the per-case plog backup logic hardcoded `/root/ascend/log/debug/plog`, so plog files were not persisted — making post-failure diagnosis of nightly perf cases impossible. Additionally, debugging a single nightly perf case currently requires the whole nightly suite to run. This PR closes the plog persistence loop (backup inside the test -> artifact upload) and enables isolated single-case debug execution in the nightly pipeline, following the same pattern as the qwen3_235b debug case in PR #37241.

## Modifications

<!-- Detail the changes made in this pull request. -->

1. `python/sglang/test/ascend/e2e/test_npu_performance_utils.py` (`_backup_plog`):
   - Resolve the plog source path dynamically: prefer `$ASCEND_WORK_PATH/debug/plog`, fall back to `/root/ascend/log/debug/plog`; warn with the full candidate list when neither exists.
   - Support recursive copy: `shutil.copytree(..., dirs_exist_ok=True)` for directories in addition to the existing per-file `copy2`, so plog subdirectories are no longer silently skipped.

2. `.github/workflows/_npu-single-node-test-stage.yml`:
   - Export `PLOG_UPLOAD_DIR=/root/.cache/tests/logs/plog/{branch_label}-{create_time}-{run_id}-{run_attempt}` in the `Run test` step (nightly-only block), mirroring the `_backup_plog` `plog_base` layout.
   - Add an `Upload plog artifacts` step guarded by `always() && inputs.is_nightly_pipeline_job && env.PLOG_UPLOAD_DIR != ''` with 7-day retention, so plog is available as a GitHub artifact even when tests fail.

3. `.github/workflows/nightly-test-npu.yml`:
   - Temporarily disable all existing nightly jobs with `if: ${{ false }}` (job definitions kept intact for easy restore).
   - Convert `nightly-perf-16-npu-a3` into `debug-nightly-perf-16-npu-a3` (same runner/config), and update `needs` and the `check-all-jobs` summary references accordingly.

4. `test/registered/npu/performance/deepseek_v4_flash/test_npu_deepseek_v4_flash_w8a8_8p_in8k_out1k_50ms.py` and `test_npu_deepseek_v4_flash_w8a8_8p_in32k_out1k_50ms.py`:
   - Register the additional `debug-nightly-perf-16-npu-a3` suite (the AST-parsed `register_npu_ci` marker supports multiple registrations per file), so `run_suite.py --suite debug-nightly-perf-16-npu-a3` selects exactly these two cases.
   - Lower `--mem-fraction-static` from 0.7 to 0.65 to leave headroom against NPU OOM during debugging.

## Accuracy Tests

<!-- If this pull request affects model outputs (e.g., changes to the kernel or model forward code), provide accuracy test results. -->

Not applicable — this PR only touches CI infrastructure (plog backup/upload, workflow scheduling) and test-case registration; it does not change model forward code or inference outputs.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

<!-- If this pull request impacts inference speed, provide benchmarking and profiling results. -->

Not applicable — no change to inference paths. The debug nightly suite (`debug-nightly-perf-16-npu-a3`) itself is the vehicle for profiling the two DeepSeek-V4-Flash 8p perf cases in isolation; results will be attached to the nightly run summary.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.
